text:
hani-ae: NorthBridge wants a 3-week PoV for invoice parsing + doc Q&A. They need a short success gates doc, golden prompts, security checklist, and a rough hosted vs dedicated cost compare. Can we align here quickly?

anita-se: scope: 1) single/multi-page invoice extraction to structured JSON, 2) document-level follow-up Q&A, 3) small reconciliation smoke test (mock PO).

matt-ml: golden set idea: 110 redacted real invoices + 40 synthetic edge cases (low-res OCR, rotated, multi-vendor). Metrics: token-level F1 per field for extraction, binary human pass/fail for Q&A. Regression set = 800 unlabeled + 150 annotated spot-checks.

omar-infra: perf/pricing note: target p95 <= 350ms at 10 QPS with ~400 tokens. Recommend Dedicated micro for stable latency; hosted reserved throughput can work for the trial. Estimated 3-week cost: hosted ~$4-8k, Dedicated prorated commit ~$3-5k + small infra setup. I'll produce a short sim by EOD.

maya-sec: security checklist before sample ingest: allowlist CIDRs, upload via encrypted S3 presigned URL or SFTP, confirm PHI/PII presence, retention window, and whether BYOK required. If BYOK/HSM or pen-test artifacts are required that'll escalate timeline.

sarah-ops: harness plan: staging cluster mirroring Dedicated config, nightly regression job, store outputs+judgments for audit, dashboards for per-field F1 and latency. Annotators booked for week 3 if we confirm now.

deploy-bot: staging env northbridge-poc ready at https://staging.northbridge.redwood.internal  creds in 1Password.

hani-ae: proposed success gates to present: - Extraction: per-field F1 >= 0.88 on golden set, - Q&A: human-eval pass-rate >= 83% on 100 queries, - Latency: p95 <= 350ms in Dedicated, - Security: checklist items answered and no high-risk findings.

anita-se: regression policy: nightly compare vs baseline; alert if F1 drops >3% absolute or Q&A pass-rate drops >6%. Auto-rollback only for severe regressions (F1 drop >6% or latency >2x).

hani-ae: blockers: 1) redacted sample set (at least 50) by Tue, 2) DPA signed, 3) confirm CIDRs/BYOK need. I'll send a one-pager and sample request after this thread.

maya-sec: I'll DM a minimal checklist for them to fill; ping me if they insist on pen test reports.

omar-infra: I'll post the cost sim and confirm eu-west capacity by EOD.

sarah-ops: we'll prepare golden prompt templates (JSON-only) and the annotation schema; will share Monday.

hani-ae: thanks — kickoff call booked Monday 10am if samples come in. :thumbsup:
